items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: It's Ronnie Cole and myself, and there's a saxophonist (what's his name?), Bob Lema.

ctx.x: You made with him? I didn't know that.
Yeah. They were floating all around Scandinavia for quite a while. It's Ronnie Cole and myself, and there's a saxophonist (what's his name?), Bob Lema. He's from Brooklyn.
